key.name: icon-size
key.description: Maximum app icon size in pixels before automatic width scaling.

key.name: bottom-margin
key.description: Distance in pixels between the dock pill and the bottom monitor edge.

key.name: dynamic-transparency
key.description: Use translucent background when clear and solid background when overlapped or in Overview.

key.name: transparent-opacity
key.description: Pill background opacity percentage when no window overlaps the dock.

key.name: solid-opacity
key.description: Pill background opacity percentage in Overview or when windows overlap.

key.name: multi-monitor
key.description: Display a dock on every connected monitor instead of only the primary monitor.

key.name: isolate-monitors
key.description: Only show running non-favorite apps and window dots belonging to each dock's monitor.

key.name: isolate-workspaces
key.description: Filter running apps and window indicators to the active workspace.

key.name: intellihide
key.description: Automatically hide the dock when overlapped by windows and reveal on bottom-edge hover.

key.name: hide-delay-ms
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before hiding the dock after the pointer leaves.

key.name: click-action
key.description: Action when clicking an app that is already focused on the dock's monitor.

key.name: scroll-switch-windows
key.description: Cycle through an app's windows when scrolling over its dock icon.

key.name: show-notification-badges
key.description: Display unread notification counts from GNOME Message Tray and Unity LauncherEntry.

key.name: show-running-dots
key.description: Display per-window indicator dots under running applications.

key.name: show-tooltips
key.description: Display the application name above hovered dock icons.
